endpoint.display: Barton Springs Dental Group interim FHIR server (WADO-RS)

note.text: The real image data is DICOM, not carried in this FHIR resource — this ImagingStudy is a pointer/metadata layer only, per HL7's own spec. It references the DICOM Study/Series UID above; actual retrieval is a DICOMweb WADO-RS call against the referenced endpoint's PACS. This is the FIRST imaging in UC04a: it is generated IN-OFFICE at Barton Springs (the originating teledentistry provider had no way to take a radiograph virtually), not exchanged between organizations — unlike UC02's dental-to-dental support-a-pull. It is not re-transmitted back to Meridian at Interaction 4; the closed-loop summary is clinical (ClinicalImpression/CarePlan) and references the radiograph's conclusion rather than the image itself.
